scope: Read-only remote diff review; no package or source mutation

reviewed_prs.title: Bump polars from 1.44.2 to 2.1.0
reviewed_prs.patch:
diff --git a/pyproject.toml b/pyproject.toml
index 1d561fb..c10024f 100644
--- a/pyproject.toml
+++ b/pyproject.toml
@@ -54,7 +54,7 @@ nlp = ["spacy>=3.8,<3.9"]
 pdf = ["pypdf>=6.21.4,<7"]
 ocr = ["Pillow>=13,<14", "pypdfium2>=5.14,<6"]
 ocr-build = ["certifi>=2026.10.23,<2027"]
-tables = ["pandas>=2.2,<4", "polars>=1.30,<2", "pyarrow>=20,<24"]
+tables = ["pandas>=2.2,<4", "polars>=1.30,<3", "pyarrow>=20,<24"]
 yaml = ["PyYAML>=6.0.2,<7"]
 training = ["numpy>=1.26,<3", "scikit-learn>=1.6,<1.10", "joblib>=1.4,<2", "faker>=30,<41"]
 benchmarks = ["psutil>=7,<8", "reportlab>=4.4,<5"]
diff --git a/requirements-constraints-windows-py311.txt b/requirements-constraints-windows-py311.txt
index 1e4a460..b35e89b 100644
--- a/requirements-constraints-windows-py311.txt
+++ b/requirements-constraints-windows-py311.txt
@@ -62,7 +62,7 @@ pip-audit==2.10.1
 pip-requirements-parser==32.0.1
 platformdirs==4.14.3
 pluggy==1.7.0
-polars==1.44.2
+polars==2.1.0
 polars-runtime-32==1.44.2
 preshed==3.0.13
 presidio-analyzer==2.2.366
reviewed_prs.reason: Broadens polars to <3 and pins polars 2.1.0 while leaving polars-runtime-32 1.44.2. The separate runtime PR must be combined and the major API migration validated; current candidate is tested with coherent 1.44.2/1.44.2.

--- a/requirements-constraints-windows-py311.txt
+++ b/requirements-constraints-windows-py311.txt
@@ -45,7 +45,7 @@ markupsafe==3.0.4
 mdurl==0.1.2
 msgpack==1.2.4

-mypy==1.20.2

reviewed_prs.reason: Broadens mypy to <3 and pins 2.4.1. Candidate currently passes supported mypy 1.20.2; the new major checker is not validated by this review and is not required to fix a reported dependency vulnerability.
